data.rationale: The proposal follows the same step order as the true workflow (Hotels, search, suggestion, dates, guests, Update, sort). It fixes the sort to price low-to-high instead of making sort or filters a parameter, and it leaves out the filters parameter, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
